g.text: Encoder: 2 × ConvNeXt block + linear attention per level
linear attention, then ↑ 2; final ConvNeXt + 1×1 conv
ConvNeXt block: depthwise 7×7 conv + time embedding, LayerNorm, 3×3 conv, GELU, 3×3 conv, residual. ↓ 2: 4×4 stride-2 conv; ↑ 2: 4×4 stride-2 transposed conv.
